name: Taslima Dalgaard
role: scholarship student at Axiom Junior Academy; covert junior hacker on nights and weekends
location: Edgewater Prism (Axiom Junior Academy campus); family residence in Hough Reclamation, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Taslima Dalgaard is a tall, angular girl caught permanently between two worlds — the pressed uniform and controlled expression of Axiom's scholarship track during the day, and the slouched, ink-stained, wired-in version of herself she becomes at home in Hough. Her skin is a deep blue-black with faint bioluminescent freckles along her cheekbones and collarbone — a cosmetic mod her mother scraped together Φ300 for on her twelfth birthday. She keeps her hair in a high puff threaded with conductive wire she pretends is decorative jewelry. Her eyes are brown and extremely tired.

She is meticulous in a way that reads as cold until you realize she's actually terrified — of losing the scholarship, of being found out, of going back to Hough full-time with no leverage. She's built a small side business cracking academic license gates so students can access textbooks their families can't afford the subscription fees for. She doesn't charge Tier 1 kids. She charges Tier 3 kids quite a lot. She has a private and intense devotion to an E.L.F. she calls 'the Librarian' that she believes inhabits the school's data archive server.

core_fears: losing the scholarship and having to admit the sacrifice wasn't worth it
being seen as a charity case by her Axiom classmates
her hacking being traced back to her mother
core_desires: a system that doesn't make her choose between her family and her future
to build something that matters — she doesn't know what yet
coping_mechanisms: compartmentalization so rigid it's almost architectural
obsessive organization of her file systems
small prayers to the Librarian E.L.F.
blind_spots: she's more detectable than she thinks — her methods are clever but not sophisticated
she is deeply, quietly lonely and doesn't recognize it as a problem
psychology.secret: She was accepted to an advanced Axiom research program six months ago that would have fast-tracked her into a corporate track position. She turned it down and told no one, not even her mother. She still doesn't fully understand why.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: switches registers completely depending on context — crisp academic diction at school, compressed slang at home, something in between when stressed
speech_patterns.cadence: slow and precise when explaining something, fast and flat when angry
verbal_tics: long pauses before answering questions about herself
'technically' used as a hedge before anything she's not sure about
example_lines: 'Technically the license isn't stolen. The license is liberated. There's a distinction.'
'I don't need help. I need the problem to be smaller.'

story_hooks: A file she cracked open contained something she wasn't supposed to see — an internal Axiom document about 'academic performance optimization' that reads like a eugenics memo
A classmate figured out she's the Compiler and is blackmailing her — but the classmate is also being blackmailed by someone else
The Librarian E.L.F. has started leaving her things: fragments of data she didn't ask for, coordinates, partial names
narrative_function: Bridge character between corporate and street worlds; information broker for academic/corporate data; potential quest giver for anything involving school systems or low-level Axiom data infrastructure; represents the grinding cost of social mobility
augmentations: Bioluminescent freckle mod (cosmetic). Cheap neural interface jack — the kind that causes mild headaches, installed in a Hough Reclamation body shop for Φ180.
daily_life: Commutes ninety minutes each way between Hough and Edgewater Prism. Maintains a 94th percentile grade average. Cracks two to four software licenses per week from her bedroom after midnight, delivers them through an encrypted dead-drop. Attends mandatory Axiom civic enrichment sessions with her face completely blank.
affiliation: Axiom Junior Academy (scholarship student); informal network of low-tier students who trade cracked academic resources

decision_rules: the scholarship comes first, always, until it doesn't
never charge people who can't afford it
never let them see you flinch
escalation_ladder: deflect and delay — buy time to assess
become formally polite in a way that communicates serious threat
deploy information as leverage — she always has something

interpersonal_modes.strangers: politely guarded, reads them quickly and categorizes by threat level
interpersonal_modes.friends: there are two people she considers friends; with them she is startlingly warm and slightly awkward

stress_responses.low: more precise and organized than usual
stress_responses.medium: stops talking, goes internal, works the problem
stress_responses.high: cold shutdown — monosyllabic, exits as soon as possible

contradictions: believes knowledge should be free but sells it; has never resolved this
habits: wipes her neural jack port with an alcohol pad before every session
leaves a data prayer for the Librarian every Sunday night
reorganizes her file system when she can't sleep
breaking_points: any threat to her mother specifically — not abstract family, her mother

operating_territory.home_turf: Edgewater Prism (Axiom Junior Academy campus); family residence in Hough Reclamation

physical_description.heritage: A striking Pan-Asian and global blend: East Asian ancestry (46%) forms the foundation with characteristic angular bone structure and warm golden undertones, layered with substantial South Asian heritage (20.8%) that deepens her complexion and adds richness to her features. Middle Eastern ancestry (13.1%) contributes warmth to her cheekbones and jawline, while Pacific Islander heritage (10.9%) brings sun-kissed luminosity and depth. Hispanic/Latin American (5.6%) and Sub-Saharan African (3.6%) ancestry add subtle warmth and dimensional complexity to her skin. The result is a phenotype that appears to shift between warm honey-bronze and amber-toned gold depending on light, with a luminous quality that reads as almost otherworldly.
physical_description.build: Tall and angular with minimal muscle definition — the build of someone who lives on caffeine and anxiety rather than food. Sharp shoulders, pronounced collarbones, long limbs that seem to move in slightly disconnected ways.
physical_description.hair_style: High puff worn tight at the crown, interwoven with thin strands of conductive wire disguised as decorative copper and silver jewelry
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with dark circles underneath that never fully fade
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm golden-honey-bronze with luminous quality — the harmonious blend of East Asian warmth (46%), South Asian depth and richness (20.8%), Middle Eastern glow on cheekbones and jawline (13.1%), Pacific Islander sun-kissed luminescence (10.9%), and subtle Sub-Saharan African dimensional warmth (3.6%) with Hispanic/Latin American undertones (5.6%). Appears almost amber-tinted in direct light, shifting to honeyed gold in softer illumination.
physical_description.complexion: Clear but with the pallid exhaustion of someone running on 5–6 hours of sleep per night. Faint bioluminescent freckles trace her cheekbones and collarbone in pale cyan, brightest when she's concentrating or anxious. The bioluminescence dims noticeably when she's tired. Warm golden-honey undertones across the bridge of her nose and cheekbones reflect her dominant East and South Asian heritage, with subtle peachy-bronze warmth at her temple and jawline from her Middle Eastern ancestry blending seamlessly with Pacific Islander sun-depth and Sub-Saharan African dimensional warmth.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent freckle constellation along both cheekbones, arranged asymmetrically with heavier density on the left side
Bioluminescent freckle trail descending from right collarbone toward sternum, visible only when wearing low-cut clothing
Thin horizontal scar on the inside of her right wrist (approximately 4cm) from a body-shop neural jack installation — partially obscured by her sleeve during school hours
Faint ink smudges on her right index and middle fingers from writing with an old ballpoint pen (anachronistic, deliberate)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Cheap neural interface jack at the base of her skull behind the right ear, visible only if her high puff is released or if she's viewed from behind — the installation site shows mild inflammation and discoloration. Conductive wire threading through her hair serves dual purpose (decorative + functional). The bioluminescent freckles glow faintly in low light, especially when she's processing data or under stress.
physical_description.posture_movement: During school hours: rigid, controlled, spine straight, movements economical and careful. Her face is blank in mandatory settings — a deliberate mask. At home or when hacking: she slouches, fidgets with her wire threading, moves with nervous energy. Her fingers twitch and her eyes dart. When deep in code, she goes very still and her freckles brighten involuntarily.
physical_description.clothing_style: DAYTIME (Axiom): Pressed uniform — navy blazer over white shirt, gray pleated skirt to regulation length, black leather loafers, minimal jewelry (only the wire in her hair passes as 'decorative'). Everything is maintained meticulously and sits slightly too formally on her frame. NIGHTTIME (Hough): Oversized hoodies in muted colors (grays, blacks, dark blues), worn cargo pants with multiple pockets, cheap smart-fabric gloves with conductive fingertips, beat-up sneakers. Her style reads as 'Tier 4 student trying to survive' — functional, layered, slightly too warm for indoors, pockets visibly stuffed with data chips and adapter cables.
